data.description: The message's data, its null fields left out.

subject.description: What the message is about, such as `github:owner/repo#42`.

labels.description: The outcome labels the task got, such as `merged-clean`.

path.description: The steps the task finished, in order, each as `step:outcome`.

description:
`case.toml`: the task a case was captured from, what it was asked, where its replay starts and
ends, and what really happened to it.

ends_at.description: The first irreversible step the task reached. A replay ends there and never runs it.

gaps.description: Why the case is partial, one line per gap.

key.description: What the task worked on, prefixed by its source, such as `github:owner/repo#42`.

partial.description:
Whether the capture left a gap: a `gh` call it could not keep, or a transcript it could not
read. A person fills each gap by hand or leaves it.

reference.description: What really happened to the task, for a reader and for scorers.

repo.description: The repository the task's worktree was cloned from, as `owner/name`.

request.description: The message that asked for the task, as the inbox recorded it.

start.description: The commit the task's worktree was created from. A replay clones the repository at it.

title: case
